tonnikalatayte-kurkkukupeissa.reasoning: Original standard serving is three cups (one quarter of the batch). Composition verified for 75 g hollowed raw cucumber (0.90 g available carbohydrate) and 37.5 g drained unflavoured water-packed tuna (0 g in the AFCD record), plus 10 g full-fat mayonnaise, 10 g celery, 2.5 g undiluted lemon juice and 1.25 g dill. Full available carbohydrate about 1.16 g. Sydney GI Research Service discusses the small glycaemic impact of unflavoured fish and low-carbohydrate salad vegetables as foods. Plate is uncooked and does not involve breading, a sweetened filling or an extra side. Food-group evidence combined with the identified ingredient portions supports a directional estimate for three cups. No numerical GI/GK inferred or universal threshold assumed. Re-review changing product, cucumber preparation, number of cups or served sides.

This partial sum cannot be shown as whole-portion data. No point or class. If the cook selects Felix EAN 6417808290610, its 2.3 g carbohydrate per 30 ml scales to 1.2778 g declared dressing carbohydrate per serving without assuming a density. The recipe calls for a fixed volume of ready-made dressing. The volume applies to any suitable dressing; the separate Felix example applies to one sixth of the batch.

If you use Felix Caesar dressing (EAN 6417808290610), the recipe’s 100 ml adds about 1.3 g carbohydrate from the dressing per sixth of the salad, using the manufacturer’s nutrition information. pinaatti-raejuustopaistos.reasoning: Original standard serving is one of six pieces of the baked egg mixture, with no side. Edible ingredients per piece before baking: 10 g spinach, 33.33 g eggs without shell, 37.5 g plain cottage cheese, 10 g mozzarella, 0.167 g smoked paprika and 0.25 g sea salt. Of the modeled about 1.06 g available carbohydrate, plain cottage cheese contributes 0.9375 g, eggs 0.10 g, spinach 0.025 g. Source nutrition estimate documents that the entire paprika mass is at most 0.167 g/serving; do not treat it as zero. Sydney GI team covers leafy vegetables and eggs as groups with small glycaemic impact. Diabetes Canada (https://www.diabetes.ca/DiabetesCanadaWebsite/media/Managing-My-Diabetes/Tools%20and%20Resources/glycemic-index-food-guide.pdf) lists cottage cheese in its low-GI group. The evidence supports directional classification of the portion of the egg and dairy dish as baked, without assigning an unmeasured ingredient or whole-dish GI. Re-review changing dairy/sweetened product, spices, preparation, pieces or additions.

herne-auringonkukkalevite.reasoning: One quarter of the spread only. Per serving: 50 g plain frozen green peas before heating by packet instructions, then drained, cooled and blended; 5 g sunflower seeds weighed before dry-toasting; 3.75 g undiluted lemon juice; 6.75 g rapeseed oil; small weighed salt and black pepper. Fineli green peas supply 4.68 g available carbohydrate of the approximately 4.90 g total. Dodd et al. 2011 Table 2 measured GI 29 (95% CI 25–34; 25 g available carbohydrate test portion) for a different brand of cooked plain frozen green peas. This directly tested the primary food family while blending, cultivar, brand and serving conditions preclude carrying that point to the spread. The qualitative estimate applies to the specified small portion and excludes suggested bread. Re-review boiled/canned substitutions, blending, recipe share or served sides. Product-specific GI or a clinical response is not assigned.

Credit: 日本食品標準成分表（八訂）増補2023年から引用. Ingredient carb projection remains text-only unless its separate source can be exposed together with the retained lotus-root link. kana-tagine-sitruunalla.reasoning: Serving step 5 suggests couscous or bread but fixes neither product nor quantity. This is a conditional side-only concentration with no adopted serving mass and no reference for cooked or pearl couscous or any bread. The existing exact GK version fixes the side and changes the prescribed preserved-lemon peel and stock, so its GK stays inside that version. Original held details include edible preserved lemon rind mass and its matched composition, actual ready-to-use stock and olive drained edible basis. Ingredient row 7 supplies 120 g green olives for four servings. Step 4 adds the olives. No pitting or draining amount, match to a specified olive product, or label composition is given. 30 g is the ingredient amount as written, not the weight of flesh after accounting for pits or brine. Fineli #34972 describes an average pitted green olive in brine and lists 0 g available carbohydrate per 100 g for that record only. Hold this comparison out of the recipe's numerical outputs. The preserved lemon row supplies one fruit and uses only the peel, optionally rinsed: the drained/rinsed rind weight and matched composition remain unknown. The onion is one unspecified onion. Stock dilution and side choice/amount remain unresolved. The approved separate GK version fixes multiple quantities and ingredients and cannot be widened.

condition.fi: Huomioi lisuke erikseen. Tavallisessa vehnäkuskusissa on noin 64 g imeytyvää hiilihydraattia 100 grammaa kuivaa kuskusia kohti. condition.en: Count the side separately. Plain wheat couscous has about 64 g of available carbohydrate per 100 g dry. briossisampylat-joshua-weissman.reasoning: Directional review for one of nine buns as published, no burger fillings. Exact source weighs 30 g wheat flour with milk and water for a heated tangzhong, then 480 g additional wheat flour, milk, yeast, sugar, salt, eggs/yolk and butter. Two rises; 190 C for 16–20 min; listed egg wash and melted butter included, no sesame. Verified available carbohydrate 49.46 g per bun, of which the two wheat flour additions supply about 41.93 g; sugar about 5.88 g. Englyst et al. 2003 primary Table 1 (p. 331), French bakery brioche 101 g test portion, GI 70 (SEM 18), and Pasquier pain au lait 94 g, GI 63 (SEM 10), for whole comparators on the glucose scale. Kim et al. 2019 (doi:10.1017/S0007114518003446, Tables 1 and 2) commercial soft wheat roll, GI 56.2 (SEM 11.1), offers a structurally similar leaner comparator. Applying each separate point to 49.46 g gives comparison-only GK 34.62, 31.16, 27.80. Different tangzhong, ingredients, baking and moisture conditions prevent transfer of a point; no comparator is a measured match or a biological bound. The source-specific comparison and 49.46 g in the defined bare bun support a likely high load, not numeric approval. Do not assign whole bun GI to flour or add the same sugar twice. Re-review on ingredient, coating, cooking or size changes. Numeric GK remains withheld in the historic research-of-record.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä tämän ohjeen yhdeksästä sämpylästä voiteluineen. Se perustuu annoksen hiilihydraatteihin ja samantyyppisen briossin mittaukseen. Tämän esitaikinan vaikutusta ei ole mitattu. Hampurilaisen täytteet eivät sisälly arvioon.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one of the nine buns, including the egg wash and butter finish. It combines this serving’s carbohydrate amount with a measurement from a similar brioche. The effect of this recipe’s cooked starter has not been measured. Burger fillings are outside the estimate.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller en av de nio bullarna, med äggpensling och smör. Den bygger på portionens kolhydratmängd och mätning av en liknande brioche. Effekten av den upphettade fördegen i receptet har inte mätts. Hamburgarfyllningen ingår inte.
rationale.th: ค่าประมาณนี้ใช้กับขนมปังหนึ่งชิ้นจากทั้งหมดเก้าชิ้น รวมไข่และเนยที่ทาหน้า โดยอ้างอิงปริมาณคาร์โบไฮเดรตต่อหน่วยบริโภคและผลวัดจากบริออชชนิดใกล้เคียง ยังไม่ได้วัดผลของแป้งกวนในสูตรนี้ ไม่รวมไส้เบอร์เกอร์

hampurilaissampylat-moomie.reasoning: Directional review for one of nine buns as published, no burger fillings. Exact recipe: 473 g semi-coarse wheat flour, 223 g water, 32 g dough butter, 55 g shell-free egg, 56 g sugar, 8 g salt and 10 g dry yeast, two rises, 190 C for 15–18 min, with 48 g butter before and after bake and 9 g sesame topping included. The retained calculation scope incorrectly mentions an egg wash, but rows and recipe agree that the weighed 55 g egg goes in dough and only butter/sesame go on top; no second egg is modeled. Available carbohydrate 45.33 g per bun includes ~38.89 g from refined wheat flour and ~6.22 g sugar. Best independent comparisons: Scazzina et al. 2016 commercial Pagnottelle soft wheat flour roll with sugar (mean GI 62, also reported by study author slide no.22), Kim et al. 2019 (doi:10.1017/S0007114518003446, Tables 1 and 2) soft roll with wheat flour, sugar, milk/fat and yeast (GI 56.2), Wolever et al. 1994 Toronto hamburger bun (mean bread-scale GI 87, glucose-scale ~62 per 2021 supplementary table no. 2212; differing participants and protocol; no double-counting tables as separate studies). The food comparisons translate to comparison-only GK around 28.1 and 25.5. Choice of flour, absence of commercial milk formulation, sugar, butter finish and sesame limit equivalence. Scazzina studied a deliberately high-fibre low-GI sliced bread (41) that would cross the boundary here, but this bun does not replace wheat flour with a fibre-enriched material. No guarantee or lower bound is inferred. No final baked match or numeric approval. Re-review size, recipe, fat finish, sides or process changes.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä ohjeen sämpylää, jossa on voita ja seesaminsiemeniä pinnalla. Se perustuu annoksen hiilihydraatteihin ja samantyyppisten vaaleiden sämpylöiden mittauksiin. Hampurilaisen täytteet eivät sisälly arvioon.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one bun with its butter and sesame topping. It draws on this serving’s carbohydrate amount and measurements from similar white rolls. Burger fillings are outside the estimate.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller en bulle med smör och sesamfrön på ytan. Den bygger på portionens kolhydratmängd och mätningar av liknande ljusa bröd. Hamburgarfyllningen ingår inte.
rationale.th: ค่าประมาณนี้ใช้กับขนมปังหนึ่งชิ้นที่ทาเนยและโรยงา โดยอ้างอิงปริมาณคาร์โบไฮเดรตต่อหน่วยบริโภคและผลวัดจากขนมปังขาวชนิดใกล้เคียง ไม่รวมไส้เบอร์เกอร์

kevyet-briossisampylat-clever-carrot.reasoning: Directional review for one of nine buns as published, no burger fillings. Exact source uses 405 g strong and 45 g semi-coarse wheat flour with water, milk, yeast, sugar, egg, salt and butter. Two rises; 205 C for 15–20 minutes, optional oven steam, listed egg wash included, no sesame or post-bake butter. Verified available carbohydrate 41.27 g per bun, ~37.0 g from flour, ~3.89 g from sugar. Englyst et al. 2003 primary Table 1 p. 331 pain au lait (GI 63) and bakery brioche (GI 70) support a comparison only; both tested products were richer in fat by available carbohydrate than this lighter recipe. Independent alternatives for a less enriched matrix: Scazzina et al. 2016 soft wheat flour roll with sugar GI 62, Kim et al. 2019 soft wheat roll GI 56.2; their comparison-only GK at this portion is 25.59 and 23.19 respectively. Differences in fat, strong flour, raises and optional steam prevent a point assignment. The 20 boundary would correspond to GI about 48.46; Scazzina's deliberately high-fibre sliced bread GI 41 is a real contrary food design, inapplicable to this recipe's conventional white flour and low fibre. Moderate load cannot be ruled out biologically; likely high is a qualitative judgement for the exact published bare bun. Do not present an interval from comparator points or SEM. Keep the numeric HOLD. Re-review flour, steam, size and serving scope changes.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä ohjeen sämpylää. Se perustuu annoksen hiilihydraatteihin sekä maitosämpylöiden ja vaaleiden sämpylöiden mittauksiin. Keveämpi taikina poikkeaa tutkimusten tuotteista. Täytteet eivät sisälly arvioon.

pohjoisafrikkalainen-msemen-hunajalla-pu.reasoning: Scoped nonnumeric review of current V2 successor, two of four pan-cooked laminated squares with 10 g of the listed serving honey; no other spread/topping. Half-batch inputs: 83.5 g refined wheat flour, 22.5 g durum semolina (including dusting used in lamination), 66.5 g water, 1.5 g salt, 16 g rapeseed oil and 14 g butter. The actual ingredient-based carbohydrate model is verified at 82.99 g/portion; the bread accounts for about 75.76 g, the 10 g honey for about 7.23 g. Published human food comparators for the bread, not its honey topping: Devindra Shakappa et al. (2022), DOI 10.1007/s13197-022-05368-6, Table 2, parota 62.48 (50 g carbohydrate test; glucose reference), a layered pan-cooked wheat flatbread, gives 47.34 comparison-only load applied to the bread's 75.76 g. Shobana et al. (2022), DOI 10.4103/ijmr.IJMR_1935_19, Table 3, methi paratha 60.2 gives 45.61; it contains fenugreek/curd and is only a secondary wheat-flatbread analogy. Vijayakumar et al. Kerala breakfast paper (2017), Table 3, reports a competing lower porotta GI 37.98 (referenced by PMC7791047, row 696), giving 28.77 under the same bread-only check. These are independent comparison points, not a physiological bound or a range for the recipe. The tests do not measure this Moroccan formulation, wheat/semolina proportions, folded oil/butter, cooking method, or honey. A directionally high estimate is supported at exactly two squares with the listed honey. Do not assign a component or whole meal GI number, estimate insulin or response, or transfer the quarantined predecessor's GK100 number. Numeric GK approval and original quarantine stay in place. Re-review ingredient, pan prep, folded fat, honey and serving changes.

karnivore-voilohi-pannulla.reasoning: One of two plain portions of the listed pan-fried skin-on salmon, with all of its allocated cooking fat and butter, without breading, sauce or side. The approximately 0.14 g available carbohydrate contribution recorded here is mainly the butter by recipe composition; label zero does not imply exact laboratory zero. University of Sydney GI research FAQ #11 supports a small expected glycaemic effect of unflavoured fish eaten alone; Holt et al. 1997 (doi 10.1093/ajcn/66.5.1264, Table 4) independently reported a low mean glucose score for its tested fish serving, not a salmon GI and not a serving-ratio proxy. There is no starch, glaze or side within the reviewed mass and preparation. This meets a directional LOW estimate for one plain portion by food-specific evidence plus complete composition. No numeric GI/GK, GK-zero, insulin demand, or individual response is assigned. Re-evaluate coating, sides, portion, product, and retained pan-fat instructions. Preserve the prior numeric approval status and recipe blobs.

karnivore-lammaskyljykset-voissa.reasoning: Exactly half of this published batch of unbreaded lamb-and-butter, with all its allocated edible butter, pan fat and resting juices, no side. Recipe computes AFCD F004923 untrimmed raw bone-in lamb 600 g × 70.8% edible basis and divides by two; this is about 212.4 g edible raw input per portion, not cooked weight, and not a fixed number of chops. Salt 2 g per portion, 12.5 g Fineli no. 500 ordinary butter at 0.8 g available carbohydrate per 100 g gives about 0.10 g modeled available carbohydrate per portion. The declared meat composition represents plain lamb. University of Sydney FAQ #11 explains the small expected glycaemic effect of unflavoured meat-only food, and Foster-Powell et al. 2002 (doi 10.1093/ajcn/76.1.5) explains the distinction between absent/untestable GI and small food-group effect for plain meats. Source evidence supports a small directional load for the weighed unsauced portion; this is not a measured lamb or dish GI, GK=0, a claim about all animal-based recipes, or a blood glucose or insulin prediction. The historical exact-blob file remains sealed with numeric GK undetermined. Re-review after a change to portion, coating, product, side, or retained butter/juices.

Neither amounts nor scores are a GI match and no insulin claim is made. No starchy item, glaze, bun or side is present; the recipe-specific known portion supports a directional LOW class. karnivore-rapea-porsaan-kylki.reasoning: One quarter of 800 g unseasoned raw skin-on boneless HK belly (EAN 2391119000004) and 6 g salt, with apportioned rendered cooking fat and juices. HK label rounded 0 g available CHO per 100 g and the audited AFCD basis support very little available carbohydrate; rounded zero is not a measured GK. Sydney GI Research FAQ #11 supports the limited glycaemic contribution of plain meats with very low available CHO. The current fixed serving has no glaze, breading, sauces or sides. Directional LOW only; numerical GK stays on HOLD. Brand, product or preparation changes require review.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä annosta maustamatonta porsaan kylkeä paistorasvoineen ja paistinliemineen. Ohjeessa on porsaanlihaa ja suolaa. Mahdollinen glaseeraus, kastike ja lisukkeet arvioidaan erikseen.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one portion of plain pork belly with its cooking fat and juices. The recipe uses pork and salt. Any glaze, sauce or sides are considered separately.

karnivore-steak-and-eggs.reasoning: One of two weighed portions contains a 180 g raw trimmed edible HK 1824 entrecôte steak, 110 g shell-free egg, 10 g butter, 1.5 g salt and the serving share of cooking juices. Audited available CHO 0.41 g, from 0.33 g in Fineli 858 egg and 0.08 g in Fineli 500 butter. Meat label rounded zero is corroborated qualitatively by AFCD and is not a measured GK. Sydney GI Research FAQ #11 plus Holt et al. 1997 Table 4 (https://doi.org/10.1093/ajcn/66.5.1264) fixed-energy beef and egg glucose scores support a directional LOW for the exact ungarnished serving. These are separate tests, not recipe GI or numeric GK. Existing numeric hold continues. A different accompaniment, recipe, product or portion needs re-review.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä annosta entrecôtepihviä ja paistettuja kananmunia voineen ilman kastiketta tai lisuketta. Annoksen pieni hiilihydraattimäärä tulee pääosin kananmunista.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one portion of ribeye and fried eggs with butter, without sauce or sides. Most of the small amount of carbohydrate comes from the eggs.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller en portion entrecôte och stekta ägg med smör, utan sås eller tillbehör. Det mesta av den lilla kolhydratmängden kommer från äggen.

indonesialainen-nasi-goreng-aamiaisriisi.reasoning: Exact current V2 is half the pan, including 150 g chilled cooked long-grain white rice, one fried egg and half the sweet soy mixture. Audited 60.95 g available CHO per serving, with rice 52.05 g (AFCD F007661) and brown sugar 7.744 g (AFCD F008969). Wolever et al. 2021, randomized crossover pilot, compared the matching carbohydrate food form including overnight-cooled and stir-fried long-grain polished rice with dextrose. Its primary outcome did not establish a glucose iAUC reduction from cooling or frying and is corroborated by the main fresh-vs-cooled plain-rice trial. The mixed meal of fried fragrant white rice tested by Osman et al. 2017 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.rsci.2017.06.001, Table 4, n=11) had lower measured GI than the plain rice point estimate, supporting caution about exact meal and rice transfer. The size of the current white rice portion plus sauce sugar and the two in-vivo preparation comparisons support a directional HIGH class. The cultivar, oil type and exact meal matrix differ. No previous recipe or study GI or GK is reused. The existing numerical hold remains active.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä annosta, jossa on 150 g pitkäjyväistä valkoista riisiä punnittuna kypsänä ja kylmänä, yksi paistettu kananmuna sekä ohjeen makea soijakastike. Riisi ja kastikkeen sokeri tuovat valtaosan annoksen hiilihydraateista.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one portion with 150 g of long-grain white rice weighed cooked and chilled, one fried egg and the recipe’s sweet soy sauce. The rice and sugar in the sauce provide most of the carbohydrate.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller en portion med 150 g långkornigt vitt ris vägt kokt och kallt, ett stekt ägg och receptets söta sojasås. Riset och sockret i såsen står för det mesta av kolhydraterna.
rationale.th: ค่าประมาณนี้ใช้กับหนึ่งที่ที่มีข้าวขาวเมล็ดยาวหุงสุกแช่เย็นชั่ง 150 กรัม ไข่ดาวหนึ่งฟอง และซอสถั่วเหลืองหวานตามสูตร คาร์โบไฮเดรตส่วนใหญ่มาจากข้าวและน้ำตาลในซอส

malesialainen-roti-canai-dhalilla-punnit.reasoning: Exact V2 serving is one laminated pan-cooked wheat roti plus half the lentil-coconut dhal, with audited 74.69 g available CHO. The roti includes 62.5 g dry wheat flour and 1.5 g added sugar before cooking (about 47.75 g available CHO together); the dhal includes 50 g dry split red lentils per serving. Robert and Ismail 2012 tested Malaysian flatbread with dhal curry and found similar iAUC to flatbread alone in their study. Tan 2010 primary thesis (https://eprints.ums.edu.my/id/eprint/662/, Table 3.1 and Figure 4.3) independently tested roti canai with dhal and reported mean GI 62.59 at the study test amount. Devindra Shakappa et al. 2022 (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9304465/, Table 2) independently tested wheat parota, another layered pan-cooked refined-wheat flatbread. Taken with the current serving carbohydrates and comparable preparation, the human measurements support directional HIGH for one roti plus this dhal. The recipes, amounts, study cohorts and exact meals differ; none are transferred as GI, GK, numerical bounds or an individual blood-glucose forecast. The numerical hold and the separate old recipe remain unchanged.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä pannulla paistettua vehnärotia ja puolta ohjeen linssi-kookosdhalista. Roti tuo suurimman osan annoksen hiilihydraateista, ja myös dhalin linssit lisäävät niitä.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one pan-cooked wheat roti and half the recipe’s lentil and coconut dhal. The roti provides most of the carbohydrate, and the lentils in the dhal also contribute.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller en pannstekt vete-roti och hälften av receptets lins- och kokosdhal. Rotin står för det mesta av kolhydraterna, och linserna i dhalen bidrar också.

raejuustopizza-kaurajauhopohjalla.reasoning: The original serving is half of the approximately 25 cm pizza, with toppings and without sides. The current complete calculation yields 12.902625 g available carbohydrate, 7.984625 g from oat flour and 4.918 g from the other ingredients. Soong et al. measured an oat-flour muffin. Parillo et al. and the Sydney GI research service tested different wheat pizza preparations, and the observations cannot establish a stable class for this thin, cottage-cheese-and-egg crust, prebaked at 200 °C before topping. No numeric or verbal glycaemic load is inferred.

condition.fi: Reseptin yksi annos on puoli pizzaa täytteineen. Tutkimuksessa mitattiin kaurajauhomuffinssi. Sen ja tutkittujen vehnäpizzojen tuloksista ei voida päätellä tämän raejuusto-kaurapohjan GK-luokkaa.
condition.en: One serving is half the pizza, including the toppings. The study tested an oat-flour muffin. Its result and the results for wheat pizzas do not establish a glycaemic load class for this cottage cheese and oat crust.
condition.sv: En portion är en halv pizza med fyllning. Studien mätte en muffins bakad med havremjöl. Resultaten för muffinsen och för pizzor med vetebotten räcker inte för att bedöma den här pizzans glykemiska belastning.
condition.th: หนึ่งหน่วยบริโภคคือพิซซ่าครึ่งถาดรวมหน้าพิซซ่า งานวิจัยวัดผลจากมัฟฟินแป้งข้าวโอ๊ต ผลของมัฟฟินและพิซซ่าที่ใช้แป้งสาลียังไม่เพียงพอที่จะจัดระดับภาระน้ำตาลของพิซซ่าสูตรแป้งข้าวโอ๊ตผสมคอตเทจชีสนี้

sitruuna-parsapasta.reasoning: Fineli Release 20 31256 gives 54.034 g available carbohydrate per 100 g of uncooked fresh egg pasta, with explicit fibre and sugar alcohols. The 250 g input is divided three ways. This is the weighed fresh-pasta component before cooking and draining. The recipe permits fresh pasta with or without egg, so the estimate is scoped to the egg-pasta reference; brand and moisture can matter. Asparagus water retention, lemon zest, Parmesan and black pepper still prevent the whole-portion estimate.

condition.fi: Luku koskee tuoretta kananmunapastaa. Jos käytät muuta fettuccinea, tarkista hiilihydraatit pakkauksesta. Finelin keitetyssä tuoreessa kananmunapastassa on noin 16,2 g imeytyvää hiilihydraattia 100 grammassa. Koko annoksen arvioon tarvitaan pastan ja parsan painot kypsennyksen ja valutuksen jälkeen.
condition.en: This estimate applies to fresh egg pasta. For other fettuccine, check the pack. Fineli lists about 16.2 g of available carbohydrate per 100 g of cooked fresh egg pasta. For a whole-serving estimate, weigh the pasta and asparagus after cooking and draining.
condition.sv: Uppskattningen gäller färsk äggpasta. Kontrollera förpackningen om du använder annan fettuccine. Fineli anger cirka 16,2 g tillgängliga kolhydrater per 100 g kokt färsk äggpasta. För att uppskatta hela portionen behövs vikten på pastan och sparrisen efter kokning och avrinning.

paahtopaistileipa-piparjuurikastikkeella.reasoning: The recipe equips four weighed slices with 60 g beef each and divides the sauce and vegetables between them. All listed topping amounts are included, using drained weights for cucumber and capers. AFCD F002220 reports directly available carbohydrate without sugar alcohols for drained capers and resolves the last unknown available-carbohydrate input. Fineli #31824 is a specific reference rye loaf for the estimate and can differ from a chosen bread; #630 is approximately 40% fat smetana. The point uses the explicitly permitted 20 g horseradish option. At 12 g instead the estimate would be about 0.28 g lower per sandwich. The two endpoint recipes are preparation choices, and distribution and final yield were not measured.

condition.fi: Yhdessä reseptiannoksessa on noin 50 g ruisvuokaleipää, 60 g paistia ja neljännes kaikista täytteistä. Laskelmassa käytetään 20 g piparjuurta koko kastike-erään ja punnitaan suolakurkku ja kaprikset valutettuina. Ruisleivän koostumus perustuu Finelin tietoon Oululaisen Jälkiuunivuoasta. Jos kastike-erään käyttää 12 g piparjuurta, yhden leivän hiilihydraattimäärä on noin 0,3 g pienempi.
condition.en: One recipe serving is a sandwich with about 50 g of rye loaf, 60 g of beef and a quarter of all toppings. It uses smetana (about 40% fat), 20 g of horseradish for the batch, and the drained weights of the pickles and capers. The rye bread reference is Fineli’s entry for Oululainen Jälkiuunivuoka. Using 12 g of horseradish in the batch reduces the carbohydrate estimate for one sandwich by about 0.3 g.
condition.sv: En portion enligt receptet är en smörgås med cirka 50 g rågformbröd, 60 g rostbiff och en fjärdedel av alla pålägg. Beräkningen använder smetana, 20 g pepparrot till hela såsen samt avrunnen vikt för gurkan och kaprisen. Uppgiften om rågbrödet kommer från Finelis post för Oululainen Jälkiuunivuoka. Med 12 g pepparrot i såsen blir mängden kolhydrater per smörgås cirka 0,3 g lägre.
condition.th: หนึ่งที่ตามสูตรคือแซนด์วิชหนึ่งชิ้น ใช้ขนมปังไรย์ประมาณ 50 กรัม เนื้ออบ 60 กรัม และเครื่องหน้าหนึ่งในสี่ของสูตร คำนวณโดยใช้สเมตานา (ครีมเปรี้ยวไขมันประมาณ 40%) ฮอร์สแรดิช 20 กรัมสำหรับซอสทั้งสูตร และชั่งแตงกวาดองกับเคเปอร์หลังสะเด็ดน้ำ ข้อมูลขนมปังไรย์อ้างอิง Oululainen Jälkiuunivuoka ในฐานข้อมูล Fineli หากใช้ฮอร์สแรดิช 12 กรัมในซอสทั้งสูตร คาร์โบไฮเดรตต่อแซนด์วิชหนึ่งชิ้นจะลดลงประมาณ 0.3 กรัม

indonesialainen-bubur-sumsum-punnittu-v2.reasoning: The 70 g dry white rice flour is cooked into the porridge and divided equally among four bowls. Fineli Release 20 182 supplies 79.3 g available CHO per 100 g with verified fibre and polyols, and groups rice flour and rice flakes. The verified batch source explicitly documents this composition proxy. The component label identifies the actual flour and explains the matching limit. PhilFCT M051 coconut-palm sugar still lacks polyol evidence and the extraction from pandan remains unquantified. The official M051 total sugars field reports 94.1 g/100 g. All 100 g coconut palm sugar goes into the syrup for four bowls, so a standard share contributes approximately 23.5 g sugars from the syrup according to the source. Keep the rice flour component.

condition.fi: Riisijauhon osuus perustuu Finelin vertailuarvoon riisijauhosta ja -hiutaleista. Kun koko siirappi jaetaan tasan neljään kulhoon, kookospalmusokerista tulee noin 23,5 g sokereita kulhoa kohti.
condition.en: The rice flour estimate uses Fineli’s reference for rice flour and flakes. Dividing all the syrup equally among four bowls gives about 23.5 g of sugars from the coconut palm sugar per bowl.
condition.sv: Beräkningen för rismjölet bygger på Finelis referensvärde för rismjöl och risflingor. När all sirap delas lika mellan fyra skålar ger kokospalmsockret cirka 23,5 g sockerarter per skål.

The readily available carbohydrate model uses Fineli baked sweet potato and unsweetened bilberry and AFCD pure maple syrup and cinnamon, together with other listed batter ingredients. No exact polyol value is inferred and no alternative point is attributed to boiled sweet potato.

condition.en: Cut the cake into eight equal slices. The estimate uses oven-baked sweet potato, weighed peeled and cooled, and includes the maple syrup and bilberries in the recipe.

papu-myskikurpitsapelti.reasoning: All ten ingredient amounts are accounted for, including all dressing and weighed edible vegetables. AFCD's butternut record matches peeled raw weight; AUSNUT 2023 provides canned drained white haricot/cannellini and natural unflavoured soy yoghurt reference (3.8 g available carbohydrate per 100 g, 2.6 g added sugar). 230 g drained beans refer to weight after the recipe rinse. Norway's fresh lemon peel and USDA's teaspoon measure support an explicit 2 g of raw zest. Water loss during roasting and any minor rinsing losses were not measured. This uses ingredients as charged and preserves all macro and GK holds.

condition.fi: Reseptin yksi annos on neljäsosa pellillisestä ja kastikkeesta. Punnitse ruusukaalit kovien kantojen poiston jälkeen ja valkopavut huuhdeltuina ja valutettuina. Laskelmassa käytetään miedosti makeutettua maustamatonta soijajogurttia ja 2 g sitruunankuoriraastetta koko erään.
condition.en: One recipe serving is one quarter of the tray and dressing. Weigh the Brussels sprouts after trimming the tough bases and the white beans after rinsing and draining. It uses lightly sweetened plain soy yoghurt and 2 g of lemon zest for the whole batch.

japanilainen-yaki-onigiri-misolla-punnit.reasoning: One serving contains two of the four equal triangles, made from 60 g dry Japanese short-grain white rice, 8 g light miso and 3.5 g sesame oil. The rice is cooked, shaped hot, pan-crisped and served promptly with a thin miso coating. Audited available carbohydrate is 45.98 g, with 44.4 g from rice and 1.576 g from miso. The model uses AFCD F007682 as a dry white-rice proxy. MEXT 01083 dry polished Japanese grain starch and sugar (75.6 per 100 g) independently supports the amount. Funatsu et al. 2016 (doi 10.3136/nskkk.63.162, Section 2(2)ii and Fig. 1) directly measured a plain Japanese rice-ball control (rice cooked in water, nori, pickled ume, sesame and salt) against glucose at 50 g carbohydrate and reported GI 76. Sugiyama et al. 2003 (doi 10.1038/sj.ejcn.1601606; Atkinson 2021 Table 1 row 2043 indexes the same experiment) assessed a commercial Japanese roasted rice ball against a rice reference. These are separate human studies of similar starch preparations. The rice variety, fat handling, coating and exact preparation differ. This evidence supports directional HIGH for the current two-triangle serving. No study GI or numerical GK is transferred. The successor numerical HOLD and its historical predecessor remain separate.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee kahta pannulla rapeaksi paistettua misoriisikolmiota. Niihin tulee 60 g japanilaista lyhytjyväistä valkoista riisiä kuivana punnittuna. Riisistä tulee lähes kaikki annoksen hiilihydraatit.
rationale.en: The estimate covers two pan-crisped miso rice triangles made with 60 g of dry Japanese short-grain white rice. The rice provides nearly all the carbohydrate.

intialainen-aloo-paratha-punnittu-v2.reasoning: One whole pan-cooked potato-filled flatbread and 30 g plain yogurt from the reviewed successor. The serving uses 50 g finely milled whole-wheat flour, 75 g peeled raw potato boiled and mashed before filling and 6 g rapeseed oil input. Audited 43.90 g available carbohydrate includes about 30.86 g from flour, 11.625 g from potato and 1.02 g from yogurt. Thakurdesai et al. 2024 Tables 1, 3 and 4 tested a control potato paratha without fenugreek additive in 15 healthy adults and reports glucose-scale GI 78.8 ± 3.6 at 50.1 g available CHO. Its potato was pressure cooked, exact flour and dough proportions are unavailable, the serving was cooled and accompanied by water, and the glucose formulation is unspecified. Independent primary Chennai human data on methi paratha (Carbohydrate profiling & glycaemic indices of selected traditional Indian foods, PMC9552392, Table III) supports the direction for a different wheat griddle flatbread with oil, curd and fenugreek leaves, with flour grade unspecified in the recipe table (GI 60.2 ± 6.7; 12 analyzed). This independent comparison reduces dependence on the sponsor-funded potato-paratha formulation while adding no measured home-recipe GI. The current serving size and two comparisons support a directional HIGH candidate only. The prior study serving, its approved scope and the successor numerical HOLD are unaffected.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä täysjyvävehnästä tehtyä, perunatäytteistä pannuleipää ja 30 g maustamatonta jogurttia. Leipätaikina ja perunatäyte tuovat lähes kaikki annoksen hiilihydraatit.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one pan-cooked whole-wheat flatbread with potato filling and 30 g of plain yogurt. The dough and potato filling provide nearly all the carbohydrate.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller ett pannstekt flatbröd av fullkornsvete med potatisfyllning och 30 g naturell yoghurt. Degen och potatisfyllningen står för nästan alla kolhydrater.

malesialainen-roti-jala-currykanalla-pun.reasoning: Robert and Ismail 2012 compared plain lacy pancake (25 g available CHO) and lacy pancake plus chicken curry containing potatoes and coconut milk (32 g available CHO), in 10 adults with type 2 diabetes, with 25 g glucose repeated three times. The AUC of the mixed meal was higher than that of pancake alone. Since CHO dose differed, the comparison cannot isolate a curry effect. The reported isolated pancake GI is not a source match to the successor wheat-and-rice batter with egg, full-fat coconut milk and oil; the test curry included potato and the current curry does not. Current 50.27 g audited available CHO includes 46.91 g from the two flour inputs. The exact scope is useful, but an unsupported proportional behavior at the larger serving would be required to derive a qualitative class from these data. Preserve the existing no-match release review. For a class, obtain a matched batter or complete mixed-meal human study, or document independent valid human comparators bracketing the impact of the changed flour and curry matrix. No transfer of GI 49 or the study's mixed-meal indexed response.

indonesialainen-lontong-sayur-aamiaiseks.reasoning: The current vegan V2 has 45.17 g available CHO per serving, including 37 g from 50 g dry white long-grain rice. It boils rice to absorption, presses it in a shallow pan, chills it promptly and reheats it once with tofu/cabbage/carrot coconut broth. Sugiarto 2015 clinical thesis tested ten healthy adults against white bread; its hot Betawi preparation uses different rice-cake cooking and vegetable matrix, and its observed comparison to bread is not a glucose-scale GI assigned to this dish. The abstract and Table 4.6 also report slightly different means. Bogor IPB Ciherang study uses a known medium-amylose cultivar cooked in banana-leaf cylinders. Hakimah et al. 2020 tested Lontong gado-gado, which uses a different peanut-sauce meal and observed substantially different response across cohorts. Wolever 2021 chilled cooked long-grain study lacks pressing and the mixed meal. This evidence is informative but cannot resolve a class across available long-grain varieties, thermal preparation and the mixed broth. Maintain numerical and class HOLD until a source matches the chosen cultivar and pressed reheat method, or a comparative meal study covers these differences.

metabolic-boost-tomaattisoseella.reasoning: Exact one cold starter glass is half the recipe, including 150 g smooth tomato passata before blending, 50 g water, 20 g onion, 10 g ginger, 13.5 g olive oil and the weighed lemon and seasonings. Audited 7.81 g available CHO, with 5.70 g from tomato and minor distributed vegetable or spice amounts. There is no separately added sweetener or accompaniment. Chlup et al. 2010 (doi 10.1177/193229681000400316, Tables 1 and 3) measured a commercial tomato soup reconstituted from powder in healthy adults using interstitial CGM against glucose. Tomato soup GI120 was 38.5 ± 12.1 (mean ± SEM), essentially unchanged through 210 minutes. This is a different tomato food, preparation and carbohydrate dose, with 16 participants represented for soup in Table 3. The 2020 tomato-juice preload trial PMID 32990608 evaluates juice before a rice load and is supportive context for the tomato preparation only. It provides no stand-alone juice GI. The low whole-serving carbohydrate and relevant measured tomato food support a directional LOW estimate for the exact recipe glass. No numeric GI/GK or preload effect is transferred; added fruit, sugar or bread fall outside the reviewed portion.

rationale.fi: Arvio koskee yhtä pientä lasillista, johon tulee 150 g paseerattua tomaattia sekä ohjeen verran sipulia, inkivääriä ja muita mausteita. Tomaatti tuo suurimman osan annoksen hiilihydraateista. Tutkimuksessa mitattu tomaattikeitto toimii vertailuna.
rationale.en: The estimate covers one small glass made with 150 g of tomato passata and the amounts of onion, ginger and other seasonings in the recipe. The tomato provides most of the carbohydrate. The study measured tomato soup, which serves as a comparison.
rationale.sv: Uppskattningen gäller ett litet glas med 150 g passerade tomater och receptets mängder av lök, ingefära och övriga kryddor. Tomaten står för det mesta av kolhydraterna. Som jämförelse används tomatsoppan som mättes i studien.
rationale.th: ค่าประมาณนี้ใช้กับแก้วเล็กหนึ่งแก้วที่มีมะเขือเทศบดกรอง 150 กรัม และใส่หัวหอม ขิง และเครื่องปรุงอื่นตามปริมาณในสูตร คาร์โบไฮเดรตส่วนใหญ่มาจากมะเขือเทศ ใช้ผลการวัดจากซุปมะเขือเทศในงานวิจัยเป็นข้อมูลเปรียบเทียบ

parsakaali-cashewpasta.reasoning: The audited whole portion contains 56.48 g available CHO. Recipe splits 250 g dry whole-wheat spaghetti into three servings, cooks according to its pack, retains some cooking water in the sauce, and adds broccoli, cashews and Parmesan. AFCD F006465 is dry wholemeal wheat pasta, 60.6 g available CHO, 9.9 g fibre and identical with/without-polyol available values per 100 g. The component estimate is 50.5 g available CHO from 83 and one-third grams dry input per serving. It is a reference-based estimate before cooking and draining, not measured retention or a brand-specific label. The 2022 crossover study doi 10.3390/ijerph19053001 tested plain wholegrain spaghetti at 50 g available CHO after boiling and reports glucose-scale GI about 38. The studied brand/product and precisely timed boiling differ from recipe generic product and complete mixed dish. Its point sits close to the medium/high GK boundary at the recipe serving; sauce and cooking losses may alter the comparison. Keep whole-recipe GK pending and use the weighed dry pasta contribution. No reviewed guide to lowering personal blood glucose is implied.

vietnamilainen-banh-bao-kananmunalla-pun.reasoning: Four enclosed steamed yeast buns are split into two servings. One serving contains two buns made with 60 g medium wheat flour and 3 g sugar in the dough, 60 g weighed raw mushrooms cooked as filling and 25 g hard-boiled egg, plus the corresponding soy and oil. Audited 48.39 g available carbohydrate, with about 47.4 g from the flour and sugar. Yang et al. 2006 Table 2 directly reports GI 88.1 ± 20.2 (SD) for refined steamed bread and 39.1 ± 13.0 for a shallot-and-meat steamed stuffed bun. The 2015 Sun et al. direct trial of another filled bun, Char Siew Pau (barbecue pork), reports GI 66 ± 7 SEM in Table 2; its discussion gives 64. A separate human steamed-bun crossover (PMC9096677) gives about 69 for its unfilled wheat control. Different fillings, dough proportions, flour grade and total yield span multiple directional categories despite the current known portion. Preserve the successor source-specific GK HOLD and its separately quarantined predecessor. The count of four small buns is locked in the data and method; the portion control can show two without assigning a GK class.

condition.fi: Yksi annos sisältää kaksi ohjeen mukaan höyrytettyä, sienellä ja kananmunalla täytettyä sämpylää. Valmis ostosämpylä tai eri täyte voi muuttaa hiilihydraattimäärää.
condition.en: One serving includes two of the recipe’s steamed buns with mushroom and egg filling. A shop-bought bun or a different filling may change the amount of carbohydrate.
condition.sv: En portion innehåller två av receptets ångade bullar med svamp- och äggfyllning. Köpta bullar eller en annan fyllning kan ändra kolhydratmängden.

ananas-kanelijuoma-sitruunalla.reasoning: One of two equal glasses uses 165 g fresh pineapple flesh weighed after removing peel and core. All pulp remains; 15 g fresh squeezed lemon and water are included. The original audited value is 18.72 g available CHO excluding at most 0.35 g weighed cinnamon per serving; 18.48 g comes from pineapple. Sandeepani and Rathnayake 2019 undergraduate symposium abstract (page numbered 49) describes a randomized five-condition crossover in 12 healthy adults comparing intact pineapple, nutrient-extractor blended pineapple and glucose. The presented points differ substantially (48 ± 7.7 SEM blended, 83 ± 10.1 SEM whole). This preliminary study does not give full ingredient, cultivar or equipment matching, and sits near a directional boundary at the recipe serving. Human whole-pineapple studies also differ across sampling; the published Redfern et al. extraction study included pineapple only within a multiple-fruit mixture and did not isolate it. Keep GK pending and publish the actual fruit weight and retained pulp scope, with no account adjustment for straining or use of juice.

condition.fi: Yhteen lasilliseen tulee 165 g ananaksen hedelmälihaa. Punnitse ananas ilman kuorta ja kovaa keskiosaa ja jätä kaikki hedelmäliha juomaan. Hiilihydraattiluku kattaa ananaksen ja sitruunamehun. Lasillisen 0,35 g kanelia jää laskelman ulkopuolelle.
condition.en: One glass uses 165 g of pineapple flesh. Weigh the pineapple without the peel or hard core and keep all the pulp in the drink. The carbohydrate estimate covers the pineapple and lemon juice. The 0.35 g of cinnamon in each glass is outside that estimate.
condition.sv: Ett glas innehåller 165 g ananasfruktkött. Väg ananasen utan skal och hård mittdel och låt allt fruktkött vara kvar i drycken. Kolhydratberäkningen omfattar ananasen och citronsaften. De 0,35 g kanel som finns i varje glas ingår inte i beräkningen.
condition.th: หนึ่งแก้วใช้เนื้อสับปะรด 165 กรัม ชั่งหลังปอกเปลือกและเอาแกนแข็งออก แล้วเก็บเนื้อที่ปั่นไว้ทั้งหมดในเครื่องดื่ม ค่าประมาณคาร์โบไฮเดรตครอบคลุมสับปะรดและน้ำเลมอน ไม่รวมอบเชย 0.35 กรัมที่อยู่ในแต่ละแก้ว

jaaiset-banaani-suklaapalat.reasoning: The original estimate is 13.94 g available CHO per one ninth of the tray, including about 7.015 g from 38.33 g peeled ripe banana, 5.33 g from 10 g dark chocolate, 1.18 g from 9.44 g peanut butter and 0.41 g from 3.33 g peanuts. The tray is broken into about nine pieces, not measured equal portions or a finished yield. Hermansen et al. human trial reports a ripeness difference for intact bananas, whereas the separate Ercan study found little difference across four ripe stages. Edo et al. report a variable response to another banana sample. Chlup et al. tested a specific 70% cocoa chocolate at a much higher carbohydrate load. The current generic dark chocolate may have different carbohydrate, and there is no direct freeze-and-mix analogue. This variation and uneven piece sizes make a directional class uncertain. Preserve the GK HOLD and describe an equal ninth of the batch as the reference; a broken piece can be larger or smaller.

condition.fi: Annosarvio vastaa yhdeksäsosaa levystä. Jos taitat erikokoisia paloja, arvioi oma palasi suhteessa koko levyyn. Suklaan hiilihydraattimäärä vaihtelee tuotteittain.
condition.en: One serving is one ninth of the tray. If you break pieces of different sizes, estimate your piece against the whole tray. The carbohydrate in dark chocolate varies by product.
condition.sv: En portion är en niondel av hela kakan. Om du bryter ojämna bitar, uppskatta din bits storlek i förhållande till hela kakan. Kolhydratmängden varierar mellan olika sorters mörk choklad.
condition.th: หนึ่งที่เท่ากับหนึ่งในเก้าของทั้งแผ่น หากหักเป็นชิ้นขนาดไม่เท่ากัน ให้กะขนาดชิ้นของคุณเทียบกับทั้งแผ่น ปริมาณคาร์โบไฮเดรตในดาร์กช็อกโกแลตต่างกันตามผลิตภัณฑ์

gluteeniton-uunipannukakku.reasoning: Step 3 weighs the named dry flour; step 7 divides the batter and measured toppings into thirteen portions. The manufacturer's 950 g product page specifies the same EAN and separately declares fibre. Only the dry oat flour input is derived. The dark mixture, milk and weighed accompaniments remain outside this line. The existing approximate whole-recipe legacy net value and the missing whole carbohydrate and GK reviews are unaffected. Current packaging and gluten-free checks still apply.

karnivore-smashburger.reasoning: One serving is two of four pan-cooked patties. Exact reviewed input per serving is 250 g raw plain Snellman 20% beef EAN 6409620011856, 5 g rendered beef tallow USDA FDC 171400, 2 g salt and half the edible pan fat and juices. The ingredient evidence estimates 0 g available carbohydrate using a rounded pack label and source-reported fibre and sugar alcohol composition. Conn and Newburgh 1936 (doi 10.1172/JCI100818) directly served separately pan-fried lean minced beef patties with minimal butter in a historical much larger weight-scaled design; the glucose response was small relative to the carbohydrate meal. Modern human data from Gaudichon et al. 2018 (doi 10.1152/ajpendo.00157.2018, n=13) find no significant rise after 120 g bovine meat alone. Holt et al. 1997 Table 4 notes a low relative glucose response for a grilled plain beef serving. Different fat levels, preparation and servings limit transfer. The exact plain recipe and measured comparison support a directional LOW only. Scope excludes buns, sides and sauces. No numeric GK, exact zero or individual response is assigned. Published batch-487 is source accounting only; its separate GK gate remains active.

Kawamura, Furukawa & Gomyo 2010 (doi 10.3136/fstr.16.247, Methods subsection c) state that a preliminary stand-alone soup check showed no detected glucose effect. Their dose-proximate soup used around 18 g paste per 200 mL hot water. The preliminary sample size and results are not shown, and the separate main 59-person rice-with-soup comparison does not provide a stand-alone miso GI or a causal mechanism for this recipe. Phase, miso, stock and adjuncts differ, and the direct supporting statement does not itself establish this recipe's response. The small audited bowl and its similar miso quantity support a directional LOW review candidate only for the single bowl as written. Keep numerical GK on HOLD. A side of rice/noodles, sweetened miso or added ingredients are outside this assessment.

omenavaahtokarkit.reasoning: Weighed 300 g peeled cored apple is cooked in water and puréed with no draining. All purée is whipped and cut into 16 pieces. Fineli #11060 peeled apple CHOAVL 8.31 g/100 g gives 1.558125 g per 1/16. Fineli #25 plain gelatine and #922 water directly report zero available CHO. Leaf weight/retention and missing independently measured gelatine polyols do not affect that direct zero. Recipe scope is ordinary plain gelatine leaf, which a manufacturer also lists as one ingredient. Added carbohydrate in a substituted flavoured dessert mix is outside the recipe. Lecerf et al. 2025 (doi:10.1002/fsn3.70844) tested two commercial apple purées without added sugar in ten healthy adults. Their glucose-scale GI averages were 42 and 46, each with SEM 3. The comparison supports cooked apple purée as a useful analogue, but those products did not use this recipe’s gelatin, whipping or cold set. The current whole-carbohydrate-only review and its F25 boundary support portion carbohydrate, with qualitative GK held pending a separate applicable review.

Retain the approved model value, identify the food and scope, and withhold its otherwise unconditional category.

Comparable varieties/country sources range around the value and the prepared dessert is not assayed. AFCD F009350 formally reports available CHO without sugar alcohols for an alcohol-based extract, regardless of unavailable separate polyols. Recipe is explicitly scoped to ordinary runny honey and 10%-fat plain Greek yoghurt for the input estimate. Macro endpoints and GK remain held.

marjakiisseli-vaniljakastikkeella.reasoning: Six servings share the same starch-thickened chilled berry kissel and dairy/egg vanilla sauce. The numerical scope note identifies the omission and never assigns the researched GI to this dish. Atkinson et al. 2021 Table 1 reports pasta GI 52 (glucose=100; 77 entries, SD 12). condition.sv: Uppskattningen gäller en sjättedel av nötköttsgrytan med sås. Riset och de svarta bönorna som föreslås till servering ingår varken i GL-uppskattningen eller i portionens kolhydratmängd.
condition.th: ค่าประมาณนี้ใช้กับสตูว์เนื้อพร้อมซอสหนึ่งในหกส่วน ข้าวและถั่วดำที่แนะนำให้เสิร์ฟคู่กันไม่รวมอยู่ในค่าประมาณ GL หรือปริมาณคาร์โบไฮเดรตต่อหนึ่งที่

amritsari-kala.reasoning: Recipe step 6 suggests unweighed mint chutney and lemon wedges. Neither is listed in the exact ingredient accounting or the nutrition source. The fixed estimate uses all 100 g chickpea flour for four portions (AFCD F003986, 9.625 g available CHO per portion) and the measured 15 g batch lemon juice in the coating is within scope but has no GI contribution. Chickpea flour uses legumes category GI 34 and contributes the entire point 3.2725. Tracked 1.61425 g omission already withholds class.

condition.fi: Yhden annoksen laskelmassa on 25 g kikhernejauhoa kalan kuorrutteessa. Hiilihydraattilukuun kuuluu myös taikinan sitruunamehu. Tarjoilun sitruunalohkot ja minttuchutney jäävät arvioiden ulkopuolelle. GK-luku muodostuu kikhernejauhosta, jolle käytetään palkokasvien GI-keskiarvoa.
condition.en: The calculation uses 25 g of chickpea flour in the coating for one serving. The carbohydrate estimate includes the lemon juice in the batter. Both estimates exclude the lemon wedges and mint chutney served on the side. The GL estimate comes from the chickpea flour, using the average GI for legumes.
condition.sv: Beräkningen använder 25 g kikärtsmjöl i paneringen per portion. Kolhydratuppskattningen omfattar citronsaften i smeten. Citronklyftorna och mintchutneyn som serveras till ingår inte i uppskattningarna. GL-uppskattningen bygger på kikärtsmjölet och ett genomsnittligt GI för baljväxter.
condition.th: การคำนวณใช้แป้งถั่วชิกพี 25 กรัมต่อหนึ่งที่สำหรับเคลือบปลา ค่าคาร์โบไฮเดรตรวมน้ำเลมอนในแป้ง ค่าประมาณทั้งสองไม่รวมเลมอนหั่นชิ้นและชัทนีย์สะระแหน่ที่เสิร์ฟคู่กัน ค่าประมาณ GL มาจากแป้งถั่วลูกไก่ โดยใช้ค่า GI เฉลี่ยของถั่วเมล็ดแห้ง

kiinalainen-hirssipuuro-taateleilla.reasoning: Różańska et al. 2020 Tables 2 and 4, glucose scale with matched 50 g available-carbohydrate portion, n=8, measured GI 56.2 ±20.6 SD. The market groats tested used 77 g dry until water was absorbed in about 15 min, cooked mass 223 g mean. The recipe uses 50 g dry per portion simmered into soft porridge with ginger and 350 ml water per serving plus more if needed, topped with dates and sesame. The examined product is not specified in the recipe. The model assigns 34.4 g available CHO to the grain, which contributes GK 19.3328 (91.25% of 21.18752). Holding the other modeled contributions fixed, GI of about 52.7479 gives GK 20. The study SD is not a recipe range. Keep the pinned number and existing independent carbohydrate, suppress unsupported high classification.

condition.fi: Yhteen annokseen käytetään 50 g kuivaa hirssiä. Ohjeessa hirssi keitetään pehmeäksi puuroksi. GK-arvio käyttää tutkimuksessa erikseen keitetyn hirssin GI-arvoa.
condition.en: One serving uses 50 g of dry millet, cooked into soft porridge. The GL estimate uses the GI of millet groats cooked separately in a study.
condition.sv: En portion innehåller 50 g torr hirs som kokas till en mjuk gröt. GL-uppskattningen bygger på GI för hirsgryn som kokades separat i en studie.
condition.th: หนึ่งที่ใช้ข้าวฟ่างแห้ง 50 กรัมต้มเป็นโจ๊กเนื้อนุ่ม ค่าประมาณ GL ใช้ค่า GI ของเมล็ดข้าวฟ่างที่ต้มแยกในงานวิจัย

classLimitation.fi: Annos on lähellä korkean GK:n rajaa. Luokkaa ei näytetä, koska hirssi keitettiin tutkimuksessa eri tavalla eikä ohjeessa määritellä hirssituotetta.
classLimitation.en: The serving’s estimate is close to the high GL threshold. The class is withheld because the study used a different millet preparation and the recipe leaves the product unspecified.
classLimitation.sv: Uppskattningen ligger nära gränsen för hög GL. Ingen klass visas eftersom tillagningen skiljer sig från studien och receptet inte anger någon viss hirsprodukt.
classLimitation.th: ค่าประมาณต่อหนึ่งที่อยู่ใกล้เกณฑ์ GL สูง จึงไม่แสดงระดับ GL เพราะวิธีปรุงต่างจากในงานวิจัยและสูตรไม่ได้ระบุผลิตภัณฑ์ข้าวฟ่าง

lihapullat-kermakastikkeessa-vhh.reasoning: The sealed four-serving calculation includes only whipping cream, 300 g from 3 dl split between the mixture and sauce; and 700 g cauliflower (175 g input per portion) boiled, drained and mashed. Fineli 631 and 322 group GI 35 and 66 respectively, contributions 0.76125 and 2.772. Recipe also lists one small onion, 2 tbsp almond flour, 1 dl stock and other rows; optional lingonberries or salad are mentioned. Neither present nor captured by omission accounting. No separate modern calculation JSON. Retain existing numeric as scoped historical output and suppress unsupported whole-serving low classification.

condition.fi: GK-laskelma kattaa neljän annoksen erässä 3 dl kuohukermaa ja 700 g kukkakaalia. Laskelmasta puuttuvat esimerkiksi lihapullien sipuli ja mantelijauho sekä kastikkeen lihaliemi. Kukkakaalille käytetään kasvisten GI-keskiarvoa ja kuohukermalle maitotuotteiden keskiarvoa.
condition.en: The GL calculation covers 300 ml whipping cream and 700 g cauliflower for four servings. It leaves out the onion and almond flour in the meatballs and the stock in the sauce. The cauliflower uses the average GI for vegetables and the whipping cream uses the average for dairy products.
condition.sv: GL-beräkningen omfattar 3 dl vispgrädde och 700 g blomkål för fyra portioner. Löken och mandelmjölet i köttbullarna samt buljongen i såsen ingår inte. Blomkålen beräknas med genomsnittligt GI för grönsaker och vispgrädden med genomsnittet för mejeriprodukter.
condition.th: การคำนวณ GL ครอบคลุมวิปปิงครีม 300 มล. และดอกกะหล่ำ 700 กรัมสำหรับ 4 ที่ โดยไม่รวมหอมหัวใหญ่และแป้งอัลมอนด์ในลูกชิ้น รวมถึงน้ำซุปเนื้อในซอส ดอกกะหล่ำใช้ค่า GI เฉลี่ยของผัก ส่วนวิปปิงครีมใช้ค่าเฉลี่ยของผลิตภัณฑ์นม

classLimitation.fi: Koko annoksen GK-luokkaa ei näytetä, koska laskelma kattaa vain kerman ja kukkakaalin.
classLimitation.en: A GL class for the whole serving is withheld because the calculation covers only the cream and cauliflower.
classLimitation.sv: Ingen GL-klass visas för hela portionen eftersom beräkningen bara omfattar grädden och blomkålen.
classLimitation.th: ไม่แสดงระดับ GL ของทั้งจาน เนื่องจากการคำนวณครอบคลุมเฉพาะครีมและดอกกะหล่ำ

jauhelihakastike-kesakurpitsanuudeleilla.reasoning: Two zucchini pieces are modeled as 700 g total, pan-cooked 2–3 min; 2 dl cream modeled as 200 g. Fineli 389 and 631 with category mean GI66/35 contribute GK 2.8875/0.5075, 85% from zucchini. The recipe contains one whole onion and 1 tbsp tomato paste as sauce components but neither is in the sealed two-row input or captured by omission accounting. No separate modern calculation JSON. Keep published recipe figures scoped to their respective methodologies and suppress low classification.

condition.fi: GK-laskelma käyttää neljän annoksen erässä 700 g kesäkurpitsaa ja 2 dl kuohukermaa. Kastikkeen sipuli ja tomaattipyree jäävät laskelman ulkopuolelle. Kesäkurpitsalle käytetään kasvisten GI-keskiarvoa ja kuohukermalle maitotuotteiden keskiarvoa.
condition.en: The GL calculation uses 700 g zucchini and 200 ml whipping cream for four servings. It leaves out the onion and tomato paste in the sauce. The zucchini uses the average GI for vegetables and the whipping cream uses the average for dairy products.
condition.sv: GL-beräkningen bygger på 700 g zucchini och 2 dl vispgrädde för fyra portioner. Löken och tomatpurén i såsen ingår inte. Zucchinin beräknas med genomsnittligt GI för grönsaker och vispgrädden med genomsnittet för mejeriprodukter.
condition.th: การคำนวณ GL ใช้ซูกินี 700 กรัมและวิปปิงครีม 200 มล. สำหรับ 4 ที่ โดยไม่รวมหอมหัวใหญ่และมะเขือเทศเข้มข้นในซอส ซูกินีใช้ค่า GI เฉลี่ยของผัก ส่วนวิปปิงครีมใช้ค่าเฉลี่ยของผลิตภัณฑ์นม

classLimitation.fi: Koko annoksen GK-luokkaa ei näytetä, koska laskelma kattaa vain kesäkurpitsan ja kerman.
classLimitation.en: A GL class for the whole serving is withheld because the calculation covers only the zucchini and cream.
classLimitation.sv: Ingen GL-klass visas för hela portionen eftersom beräkningen bara omfattar zucchinin och grädden.
classLimitation.th: ไม่แสดงระดับ GL ของทั้งจาน เนื่องจากการคำนวณครอบคลุมเฉพาะซูกินีและครีม

kanakorma-kukkakaaliriisilla.reasoning: Four servings of korma with grated cauliflower fried 4–5 min, never a rice grain. The sealed input includes only 600 g cauliflower, 200 g whipping cream and 150 g Turkish yogurt, Fineli 322/631/32201. Cauliflower group GI66 contributes 2.376 (69% of 3.447875), dairy group GI35 supplies remaining 1.071875. Current recipe includes one whole onion and two teaspoons korma seasoning for sauce, not tracked among omissions. No separate modern calculation JSON. Keep historical value scoped and suppress low classification.

condition.fi: GK-laskelma kattaa neljän annoksen erässä 600 g kukkakaalia, 2 dl kuohukermaa ja 150 g jogurttia. Kastikkeen sipuli ja kormamauste jäävät laskelman ulkopuolelle. Kukkakaalille käytetään kasvisten GI-keskiarvoa. Kerman ja jogurtin GK-osuudet käyttävät maitotuotteiden keskiarvoa.
condition.en: The GL calculation covers 600 g cauliflower, 200 ml whipping cream and 150 g yogurt for four servings. It leaves out the onion and korma seasoning in the sauce. The cauliflower uses the average GI for vegetables. The cream and yogurt use the average for dairy products.
condition.sv: GL-beräkningen omfattar 600 g blomkål, 2 dl vispgrädde och 150 g yoghurt för fyra portioner. Löken och kormakryddan i såsen ingår inte. Blomkålen beräknas med genomsnittligt GI för grönsaker. Grädden och yoghurten beräknas med genomsnittet för mejeriprodukter.
condition.th: การคำนวณ GL ครอบคลุมดอกกะหล่ำ 600 กรัม วิปปิงครีม 200 มล. และโยเกิร์ต 150 กรัมสำหรับ 4 ที่ โดยไม่รวมหอมหัวใหญ่และเครื่องเทศคอร์มาในซอส ดอกกะหล่ำใช้ค่า GI เฉลี่ยของผัก ส่วนครีมและโยเกิร์ตใช้ค่าเฉลี่ยของผลิตภัณฑ์นม

classLimitation.fi: Koko annoksen GK-luokkaa ei näytetä, koska laskelma kattaa vain kukkakaalin, kerman ja jogurtin.
classLimitation.en: A GL class for the whole serving is withheld because the calculation covers only the cauliflower, cream and yogurt.
classLimitation.sv: Ingen GL-klass visas för hela portionen eftersom beräkningen bara omfattar blomkålen, grädden och yoghurten.
classLimitation.th: ไม่แสดงระดับ GL ของทั้งจาน เนื่องจากการคำนวณครอบคลุมเฉพาะดอกกะหล่ำ ครีม และโยเกิร์ต

uunibataatit-fetalla.reasoning: All four orange-fleshed potatoes are weighed raw with the skins, then baked as eight halves served with all toppings. Two similarly sized halves provide one fourth of the weighed ingredient inputs. AUSNUT F010942 is the scoped raw unpeeled food reference; its available-carbohydrate value was transferred from the reference for orange-fleshed peeled sweet potato, while unpeeled moisture/fibre were analysed. The estimate only applies to the cooked skin-eaten scenario. AFCD resolves chilli and edible spring onion. The small whole unhulled sesame reference matches seed form and is not a black-cultivar analysis. No finished yield, exact nutrient retention or original GK was measured.

condition.fi: Yksi reseptiannos on kaksi samankokoista uunissa paahdettua puolikasta täytteineen. Se käyttää noin 350 g raakaa oranssimaltoista bataattia annosta kohti, ja myös kuori syödään.
condition.en: One recipe serving is two similarly sized roasted halves with the toppings. It uses about 350 g of raw orange-fleshed sweet potato per serving and includes the skin.
condition.sv: En portion enligt receptet är två ungefär lika stora ugnsrostade halvor med fyllning. Den räknar med cirka 350 g rå sötpotatis med orange fruktkött per portion, och skalet ingår.
condition.th: หนึ่งที่ตามสูตรคือมันเทศอบสองซีกขนาดใกล้เคียงกันพร้อมเครื่องโรย คำนวณจากมันเทศเนื้อสีส้มดิบประมาณ 350 กรัมต่อที่ และรวมเปลือกที่รับประทานด้วย

The carbohydrate value was imputed from matched orange-fleshed peeled ingredients; moisture and fibre come from a national analysis of unpeeled specimens. The original 1,400 g is weighed raw with washed skins, cut into halves and roasted. The model scopes eating cooked skins and divides four equal input masses. It does not substitute a baked-per-100-g value on the raw weight.

compositionMatches.matchEvidence: Fineli #385 reference for dry whole unhulled sesame, 0.9 g available per 100 g and 8.5 g/tablespoon. The black cultivar is not distinguished in Fineli. Thai FCD C128 oven-dried black sesame reports a different 2.75 g by difference which would change the whole estimate by 0.02 g, so this component's limited variation is not a dominant uncertainty.

paahtopaistileivat-kauralesesampyloilla.reasoning: The linked Batch 9 recipe yields eight rolls with 25.5245 g available carbohydrate per batch. Two rolls split between four sandwiches contribute 1.59528125 g per sandwich. The fitting AFCD F002220 source covers drained capers. One quarter of the other filling ingredients adds 2.976575 g with 20 g horseradish per sauce batch and 0.28122 g less with 12 g. The whole sandwich estimate uses the 20 g option and displays the difference for 12 g. Roast beef, mayonnaise, 40% smetana, mustard, lemon juice, arugula, drained pickles, onion and black pepper use the pinned sandwich calculation. No cooked bread weight or measured mixed-food GI is inferred.

condition.fi: Annokseen kuuluu puolikas kauralesesämpylä, noin 60 g paahtopaistia ja neljännes kastikkeesta ja muista täytteistä. Arviossa on 8 g seesaminsiemeniä kahdeksan sämpylän erässä, 40-prosenttista smetanaa, valutetut suolakurkut ja kaprikset sekä 20 g piparjuurta koko kastike-erässä. Jos käytät kastikkeeseen 12 g piparjuurta, annoksessa on noin 0,3 g vähemmän imeytyvää hiilihydraattia.
condition.en: One serving includes half an oat bran roll, about 60 g of roast beef and a quarter of the sauce and other toppings. The estimate uses 8 g of sesame seeds for eight rolls, 40% smetana, drained pickles and capers, and 20 g of horseradish in the sauce batch. Using 12 g of horseradish in the batch lowers available carbohydrate by about 0.3 g per serving.
condition.sv: En portion innehåller en halv havreklifralla, cirka 60 g rostbiff och en fjärdedel av såsen och övriga pålägg. Uppskattningen utgår från 8 g sesamfrön till åtta frallor, 40-procentig smetana, avrunnen saltgurka och kapris samt 20 g pepparrot i hela såsen. Med 12 g pepparrot i såsen blir mängden tillgängliga kolhydrater cirka 0,3 g lägre per portion.
condition.th: หนึ่งที่มีขนมปังรำข้าวโอ๊ตครึ่งชิ้น เนื้ออบประมาณ 60 กรัม และซอสกับเครื่องหน้าหนึ่งในสี่ของสูตร ค่านี้ใช้งา 8 กรัมต่อขนมปังแปดชิ้น สเมตานาที่มีไขมัน 40% แตงกวาดองและเคเปอร์ที่สะเด็ดน้ำแล้ว และฮอร์สแรดิช 20 กรัมต่อซอสทั้งสูตร หากใช้ฮอร์สแรดิช 12 กรัม คาร์โบไฮเดรตที่ย่อยได้จะลดลงประมาณ 0.3 กรัมต่อที่
